summary: Iteration 3 - validated real-USDT deposit/withdrawal chain-verification flow and cleaned branding wording. Backend: 16/16 new tests pass covering payment-method address validation (TRC20 base58+checksum, BEP20 0x+40hex; invalid rejected 400), deposit creation (placeholder address -> 400 'not configured yet', valid address returns draft with expected_display + 4-decimal offset + expires_at), deposit submit (bad hash -> 400 'hexadecimal', bad evidence folder rejected), withdrawal destination validation (bad TRON/BEP20 -> 400), admin deposit actions (credit_onchain requires submitted reference, 'verify' no longer accepted -> 422), admin withdrawal completed requires payout hash, reconciliation consistent=true. Frontend: /app/deposit shows new PayStep flow (deposit-pay-step/deposit-exact-amount/copy-amount-btn/deposit-reference-input/deposit-screenshot/deposit-submit-btn, Re-check button for pending), placeholder address returns 'This payment method is not configured yet' banner. Risk notices present on homepage plans+rewards sections, /app/plans, /app/rewards, /rewards/:slug. No 'DEMO MODE' badge in dashboard; no 'Hypothetical' plan tags; no 'Demo' hero eyebrow. Admin finance page intact.

issues: Availability still reads '{inventory} concept units' - leftover 'concept' wording. Should be 'units' or 'spots'.

action_items: Remove 'concept units' wording in /app/frontend/src/pages/RewardDetail.jsx:71 - change `${r.inventory} concept units` to `${r.inventory} units` (last 'concept' leftover from branding cleanup).

Optional cleanup: unused DemoTag import still present in /app/frontend/src/pages/app/UserPages.jsx, TeamPages.jsx, admin/AdminContent.jsx and the DemoTag export in /app/frontend/src/components/common.jsx line 81 is dead code - safe to delete.

AdminFinance.jsx line 132 uses label 'Plan amounts (coins)' bound to `lia.data.hypothetical_deposits` field - admin-facing only, but the backend key is still named `hypothetical_deposits` in /api/admin/liability; rename to `plan_coin_deposits` for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: chain.py tron_hex: good base58+double-sha256 checksum validation. find_transfer uses contract-address matching correctly on both chains.

routes_user.create_deposit: 3-open-draft limit counts only status='draft' but OPEN_DEP includes 'pending_verification'. If a user has 3 pending_verification plus 1 new draft they can keep stacking. Consider counting both statuses in the limit check (line 358).

routes_user.submit_deposit: `verify_asset` call happens before the atomic status transition - if evidence verifies but transition fails (409/400) the evidence row is orphaned (inserted at line 388 even if find_one_and_update returns None). Move evidence insert after the atomic update succeeds.
routes_admin.withdrawal_action: when 'completed' action fails on chain lookup (503) the frontend has no way to retry without reopening - acceptable, but ensure UI surfaces the 503 clearly.

No unique index on payment_submissions.reference_norm visible from code - duplicate-hash detection relies on find_one first then insert which has a race. The DuplicateKeyError catch at submit_deposit:395 suggests an index exists; verify db.payment_submissions has unique index on (method_type, reference_norm).

chain.check_deposit retries on ChainError via 60s backoff - good. However recheck_deposits in jobs.py runs every 30s and only picks up `next_check_at <= now` entries; expired draft deposits get force-failed inside recheck_deposits (not in create_deposit) which means expiry happens in bursts of 30s - acceptable.
